listing.name: Doom II RPG / DoomIIRPG-RE
listing.summary: Play Doom II RPG with the upstream Windows player and your original iOS game package.

steps.title: Supply the original iOS package
steps.instruction: Keep your permitted original Doom 2 RPG.ipa beside DoomIIRPG.exe, using that exact filename. This player reads the iOS package; BREW/J2ME rendering or cheat descriptions do not establish alternate game-data support.

steps.title: Complete the Windows prerequisites
steps.instruction: Extract the complete Windows ZIP into a separate working folder. Upstream requires OpenAL 1.1 on Windows; use its documented runtime installation if it is missing.

steps.title: Select the player and keep your saves
steps.instruction: Finish setup with DoomIIRPG.exe and the same folder, then choose Play. Back up the original IPA and the Doom2rpg.app save/settings folder when applying upstream updates.

steps.title: Keep external ownership and deliberate Play
steps.instruction: Register the real Windows player with its matching working directory and separate literal arguments; do not select a converter, installer or updater as the game player. Complete any original-data or prerequisite setup deliberately through upstream instructions. Registration does not perform or authenticate that preparation, and Play is a separate explicit action. You and upstream own this external runtime, original files, saves, settings and profiles. Preserve the complete working copy and every actual data/profile location with the game closed before upstream replacement. Registration-only removal preserves all external files; managed Install, Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and external deletion are unavailable.
